name: Can restoration maintenance help improve my property's energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can restoration maintenance help improve my property's energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, restoration maintenance can contribute to improved energy efficiency, particularly if the initial restoration included upgrades to insulation, windows, or sealing. Regular maintenance checks can identify and address issues like drafts, failing seals, or damaged insulation that could lead to energy loss. By maintaining these elements, you ensure they continue to perform optimally, helping to reduce heating and cooling costs and improve overall energy performance of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, restoration maintenance can improve energy efficiency by addressing issues like drafts, failing seals, or damaged insulation. Maintaining these elements helps reduce energy loss and costs.
